    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BoreInstaller
    Resolves a configured Bore executable or installs a verified managed release.
    BoreOutput
    Recognizes public-port announcements from the pinned Bore client.
    BridgeCommands
    Receives ACF command invocations for tunnel status and lifecycle management.
    BridgeSettings
    Captures validated bridge configuration for asynchronous tunnel operations.
    BridgeSettings.Binary
    Stores managed-download policy, an optional executable path and download timeout.
    BridgeSettings.Health
    Stores public-probe enablement, timing and the consecutive-failure threshold.
    BridgeSettings.Local
    Stores the resolved Minecraft listener and automatic-detection preference.
    BridgeSettings.Reconnect
    Stores retry enablement, capped delay bounds and the optional attempt limit.
    BridgeSettings.Relay
    Stores relay endpoints, public-port selection and the optional shared secret.
    BridgeSettings.Startup
    Stores whether and when automatic tunnel startup should be scheduled.
    ChatUI
    Renders Adventure chat panels with configured text and permission-aware actions.
    Messages
    Loads and validates configurable command, tunnel and framework messages.
    Messages.Appearance
    Retains validated literal messages and theme colors for one render snapshot.
    MinecraftStatusProbe
    Checks a Minecraft Java listener using the status handshake and ping exchange.
    PlayerJoinListener
    Shows the current connection address to authorized joining players.
    PortBridgePlugin
    Coordinates the lifecycle of PortBridge and its shared tunnel services.
    RetryPolicy
    Calculates bounded exponential reconnect delays and retry eligibility.
    SettingsLoader
    Validates configuration before publishing an immutable bridge settings value.
    TunnelService
    Owns one native Bore client and serializes its asynchronous lifecycle.
    TunnelSnapshot
    Provides an immutable view of the current tunnel for commands and notifications.
    TunnelState
    Describes preparation, connection, route health and terminal tunnel states.
